audit_status.source_base: ChatGPT-authored Psalms completion draft using public-domain KJV as familiar alignment scaffold with curated Hebrew/textual overrides; full WLC/OSHB/source-witness audit pending
audit_status.review_note: Confession, wilderness memory, idolatry, child sacrifice, violence, exile, and mercy.

verses.restored: Praise ye YHWH. O give thanks to YHWH; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

familiar.text: Praise ye the LORD. O give thanks unto the LORD; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

modern.text: Hallelujah! Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.

original.text: הַֽלְלוּ יָ֨הּ הוֹד֣וּ לַיהוָ֣ה כִּי ט֑וֹב כִּ֖י לְעוֹלָ֣ם חַסְדּֽוֹ

verses.restored: Who can utter the mighty acts of YHWH? who can show forth all his praise?

familiar.text: Who can utter the mighty acts of the LORD? who can shew forth all his praise?

modern.text: Who can describe the mighty acts of the LORD or fully proclaim His praise?

original.text: מִ֗י יְ֭מַלֵּל גְּבוּר֣וֹת יְהוָ֑ה יַ֝שְׁמִ֗יעַ כָּל תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ

verses.restored: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times.

familiar.text: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times.

modern.text: Blessed are those who uphold justice, who practice righteousness at all times.

original.text: אַ֭שְׁרֵי שֹׁמְרֵ֣י מִשְׁפָּ֑ט עֹשֵׂ֖ה צְדָקָ֣ה בְכָל עֵֽת

verses.restored: Remember me, O YHWH, with the favour that thou bearest to thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;

familiar.text: Remember me, O LORD, with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;

modern.text: Remember me, O LORD, in Your favor to Your people; visit me with Your salvation,

original.text: זָכְרֵ֣נִי יְ֭הוָה בִּרְצ֣וֹן עַמֶּ֑ךָ פָּ֝קְדֵ֗נִי בִּישׁוּעָתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.

familiar.text: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.

modern.text: that I may see the prosperity of Your chosen ones, and rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, and give glory with Your inheritance.

original.text: לִרְא֤וֹת בְּט֘וֹבַ֤ת בְּחִירֶ֗יךָ לִ֭שְׂמֹחַ בְּשִׂמְחַ֣ת גּוֹיֶ֑ךָ לְ֝הִתְהַלֵּ֗ל עִם נַחֲלָתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

familiar.text: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

modern.text: We have sinned like our fathers; we have done wrong and acted wickedly.

original.text: חָטָ֥אנוּ עִם אֲבוֹתֵ֗ינוּ הֶעֱוִ֥ינוּ הִרְשָֽׁעְנוּ

verses.restored: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.

familiar.text: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.

modern.text: Our fathers in Egypt did not grasp Your wonders or remember Your abundant kindness; but they rebelled by the sea, there at the Red Sea.

original.text: אֲב֘וֹתֵ֤ינוּ בְמִצְרַ֨יִם לֹא הִשְׂכִּ֬ילוּ נִפְלְאוֹתֶ֗יךָ לֹ֣א זָ֭כְרוּ אֶת רֹ֣ב חֲסָדֶ֑יךָ וַיַּמְר֖וּ עַל יָ֣ם בְּיַם סֽוּף

verses.restored: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.

familiar.text: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.

modern.text: Yet He saved them for the sake of His name, to make His power known.

original.text: וַֽ֭יּוֹשִׁיעֵם לְמַ֣עַן שְׁמ֑וֹ לְ֝הוֹדִ֗יעַ אֶת גְּבוּרָתֽוֹ

verses.restored: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.

familiar.text: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.

modern.text: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; He led them through the depths as through a desert.

original.text: וַיִּגְעַ֣ר בְּיַם ס֭וּף וַֽיֶּחֱרָ֑ב וַיּוֹלִיכֵ֥ם בַּ֝תְּהֹמ֗וֹת כַּמִּדְבָּֽר

verses.restored: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

familiar.text: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

modern.text: He saved them from the hand that hated them; He redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

original.text: וַֽ֭יּוֹשִׁיעֵם מִיַּ֣ד שׂוֹנֵ֑א וַ֝יִּגְאָלֵ֗ם מִיַּ֥ד אוֹיֵֽב

verses.restored: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.

familiar.text: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.

modern.text: The waters covered their foes; not one of them remained.

original.text: וַיְכַסּוּ מַ֥יִם צָרֵיהֶ֑ם אֶחָ֥ד מֵ֝הֶ֗ם לֹ֣א נוֹתָֽר

verses.restored: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.

familiar.text: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.

modern.text: Then they believed His promises and sang His praise.

original.text: וַיַּאֲמִ֥ינוּ בִדְבָרָ֑יו יָ֝שִׁ֗ירוּ תְּהִלָּתֽוֹ

verses.restored: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:

familiar.text: They soon forgat his works; they waited not for his counsel:

modern.text: Yet they soon forgot His works and failed to wait for His counsel.

original.text: מִֽ֭הֲרוּ שָׁכְח֣וּ מַעֲשָׂ֑יו לֹֽא חִ֝כּ֗וּ לַעֲצָתֽוֹ

verses.restored: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert.

familiar.text: But lusted exceedingly in the wilderness, and tempted God in the desert.

modern.text: They craved intensely in the wilderness and tested God in the desert.

original.text: וַיִּתְאַוּ֣וּ תַ֭אֲוָה בַּמִּדְבָּ֑ר וַיְנַסּוּ אֵ֝֗ל בִּֽישִׁימֽוֹן

verses.restored: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.

familiar.text: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.

modern.text: So He granted their request, but sent a wasting disease upon them.

original.text: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן לָ֭הֶם שֶׁאֱלָתָ֑ם וַיְשַׁלַּ֖ח רָז֣וֹן בְּנַפְשָֽׁם

verses.restored: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of YHWH.

familiar.text: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of the LORD.

modern.text: In the camp they envied Moses, as well as Aaron, the holy one of the LORD.

original.text: וַיְקַנְא֣וּ לְ֭מֹשֶׁה בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה לְ֝אַהֲרֹ֗ן קְד֣וֹשׁ יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

familiar.text: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

modern.text: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan; it covered the assembly of Abiram.

original.text: תִּפְתַּח אֶ֭רֶץ וַתִּבְלַ֣ע דָּתָ֑ן וַ֝תְּכַ֗ס עַל עֲדַ֥ת אֲבִירָֽם

verses.restored: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.

familiar.text: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.

modern.text: Then fire blazed through their company; flames consumed the wicked.

original.text: וַתִּבְעַר אֵ֥שׁ בַּעֲדָתָ֑ם לֶ֝הָבָ֗ה תְּלַהֵ֥ט רְשָׁעִֽים

verses.restored: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.

familiar.text: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.

modern.text: At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped a molten image.

original.text: יַעֲשׂוּ עֵ֥גֶל בְּחֹרֵ֑ב וַ֝יִּשְׁתַּחֲו֗וּ לְמַסֵּכָֽה

verses.restored: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.

familiar.text: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.

modern.text: They exchanged their Glory for the image of a grass-eating ox.

original.text: וַיָּמִ֥ירוּ אֶת כְּבוֹדָ֑ם בְּתַבְנִ֥ית שׁ֝֗וֹר אֹכֵ֥ל עֵֽשֶׂב

verses.restored: They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;

familiar.text: They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;

modern.text: They forgot God their Savior, who did great things in Egypt,

original.text: שָׁ֭כְחוּ אֵ֣ל מוֹשִׁיעָ֑ם עֹשֶׂ֖ה גְדֹל֣וֹת בְּמִצְרָֽיִם

verses.restored: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.

familiar.text: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.

modern.text: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.

original.text: נִ֭פְלָאוֹת בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חָ֑ם נ֝וֹרָא֗וֹת עַל יַם סֽוּף

verses.restored: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.

familiar.text: Therefore he said that he would destroy them, had not Moses his chosen stood before him in the breach, to turn away his wrath, lest he should destroy them.

modern.text: So He said He would destroy them— had not Moses His chosen one stood before Him in the breach to divert His wrath from destroying them.

original.text: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר לְֽהַשְׁמִ֫ידָ֥ם לוּלֵ֡י מֹ֘שֶׁ֤ה בְחִיר֗וֹ עָמַ֣ד בַּפֶּ֣רֶץ לְפָנָ֑יו לְהָשִׁ֥יב חֲ֝מָת֗וֹ מֵֽהַשְׁחִֽית

verses.restored: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:

familiar.text: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:

modern.text: They despised the pleasant land; they did not believe His promise.

original.text: וַֽ֭יִּמְאֲסוּ בְּאֶ֣רֶץ חֶמְדָּ֑ה לֹֽא הֶ֝אֱמִ֗ינוּ לִדְבָרֽוֹ

verses.restored: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not to the voice of YHWH.

familiar.text: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of the LORD.

modern.text: They grumbled in their tents and did not listen to the voice of the LORD.

original.text: וַיֵּרָגְנ֥וּ בְאָהֳלֵיהֶ֑ם לֹ֥א שָׁ֝מְע֗וּ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:

familiar.text: Therefore he lifted up his hand against them, to overthrow them in the wilderness:

modern.text: So He raised His hand and swore to cast them down in the wilderness,

original.text: וַיִּשָּׂ֣א יָד֣וֹ לָהֶ֑ם לְהַפִּ֥יל א֝וֹתָ֗ם בַּמִּדְבָּֽר

verses.restored: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.

familiar.text: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.

modern.text: to disperse their offspring among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.

original.text: וּלְהַפִּ֣יל זַ֭רְעָם בַּגּוֹיִ֑ם וּ֝לְזָרוֹתָ֗ם בָּאֲרָצֽוֹת

verses.restored: They joined themselves also to Baalpeor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

familiar.text: They joined themselves also unto Baalpeor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

modern.text: They yoked themselves to Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods.

original.text: וַ֭יִּצָּ֣מְדוּ לְבַ֣עַל פְּע֑וֹר וַ֝יֹּאכְל֗וּ זִבְחֵ֥י מֵתִֽים

verses.restored: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.

familiar.text: Thus they provoked him to anger with their inventions: and the plague brake in upon them.

modern.text: So they provoked the LORD to anger with their deeds, and a plague broke out among them.

original.text: וַ֭יַּכְעִיסוּ בְּמַֽעַלְלֵיהֶ֑ם וַתִּפְרָץ בָּ֝֗ם מַגֵּפָֽה

verses.restored: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.

familiar.text: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.

modern.text: But Phinehas stood and intervened, and the plague was restrained.

original.text: וַיַּעֲמֹ֣ד פִּֽ֭ינְחָס וַיְפַלֵּ֑ל וַ֝תֵּעָצַ֗ר הַמַּגֵּפָֽה

verses.restored: And that was counted to him for righteousness to all generations for evermore.

familiar.text: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.

modern.text: It was credited to him as righteousness for endless generations to come.

original.text: וַתֵּחָ֣שֶׁב ל֭וֹ לִצְדָקָ֑ה לְדֹ֥ר וָ֝דֹ֗ר עַד עוֹלָֽם

verses.restored: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:

familiar.text: They angered him also at the waters of strife, so that it went ill with Moses for their sakes:

modern.text: At the waters of Meribah they angered the LORD, and trouble came to Moses because of them.

original.text: וַ֭יַּקְצִיפוּ עַל מֵ֥י מְרִיבָ֑ה וַיֵּ֥רַע לְ֝מֹשֶׁ֗ה בַּעֲבוּרָֽם

verses.restored: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.

familiar.text: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.

modern.text: For they rebelled against His Spirit, and Moses spoke rashly with his lips.

original.text: כִּֽי הִמְר֥וּ אֶת רוּח֑וֹ וַ֝יְבַטֵּ֗א בִּשְׂפָתָֽיו

verses.restored: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom YHWH commanded them:

familiar.text: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the LORD commanded them:

modern.text: They did not destroy the peoples as the LORD had commanded them,

original.text: לֹֽא הִ֭שְׁמִידוּ אֶת הָֽעַמִּ֑ים אֲשֶׁ֤ר אָמַ֖ר יְהוָ֣ה לָהֶֽם

verses.restored: But were mingled among the nations, and learned their works.

familiar.text: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.

modern.text: but they mingled with the nations and adopted their customs.

original.text: וַיִּתְעָרְב֥וּ בַגּוֹיִ֑ם וַֽ֝יִּלְמְד֗וּ מַֽעֲשֵׂיהֶֽם

verses.restored: And they served their idols: which were a snare to them.

familiar.text: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.

modern.text: They worshiped their idols, which became a snare to them.

original.text: וַיַּעַבְד֥וּ אֶת עֲצַבֵּיהֶ֑ם וַיִּהְי֖וּ לָהֶ֣ם לְמוֹקֵֽשׁ

verses.restored: They sacrificed their sons and daughters to the shedim [demons].

familiar.text: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,

notes.title: Shedim
notes.body: Hebrew shedim is commonly rendered demons. The verse condemns child sacrifice within the psalm’s historical-theological retelling; it must never be used to demonize living religions, cultures, or spiritual practitioners.

modern.text: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.

original.text: וַיִּזְבְּח֣וּ אֶת בְּ֭נֵיהֶם וְאֶת בְּנֽוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם לַשֵּֽׁדִים

verses.restored: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.

familiar.text: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.

modern.text: They shed innocent blood— the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was polluted with blood.

original.text: וַיִּֽשְׁפְּכ֨וּ דָ֪ם נָקִ֡י דַּם בְּנֵ֘יהֶ֤ם וּֽבְנוֹתֵיהֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁ֣ר זִ֭בְּחוּ לַעֲצַבֵּ֣י כְנָ֑עַן וַתֶּחֱנַ֥ף הָ֝אָ֗רֶץ בַּדָּמִֽים

verses.restored: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.

familiar.text: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.

modern.text: They defiled themselves by their actions and prostituted themselves by their deeds.

original.text: וַיִּטְמְא֥וּ בְמַעֲשֵׂיהֶ֑ם וַ֝יִּזְנוּ֗ בְּמַֽעַלְלֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: Therefore was the wrath of YHWH kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.

familiar.text: Therefore was the wrath of the LORD kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.

modern.text: So the anger of the LORD burned against His people, and He abhorred His own inheritance.

original.text: וַיִּֽחַר אַ֣ף יְהוָ֣ה בְּעַמּ֑וֹ וַ֝יְתָעֵ֗ב אֶת נַחֲלָתֽוֹ

verses.restored: And he gave them into the hand of the nations; and they that hated them ruled over them.

familiar.text: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.

modern.text: He delivered them into the hand of the nations, and those who hated them ruled over them.

original.text: וַיִּתְּנֵ֥ם בְּיַד גּוֹיִ֑ם וַֽיִּמְשְׁל֥וּ בָ֝הֶ֗ם שֹׂנְאֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.

familiar.text: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.

modern.text: Their enemies oppressed them, and subdued them under their hand.

original.text: וַיִּלְחָצ֥וּם אוֹיְבֵיהֶ֑ם וַ֝יִּכָּנְע֗וּ תַּ֣חַת יָדָֽם

verses.restored: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.

familiar.text: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.

modern.text: Many times He rescued them, but they were bent on rebellion and sank down in their iniquity.

original.text: פְּעָמִ֥ים רַבּ֗וֹת יַצִּ֫ילֵ֥ם וְ֭הֵמָּה יַמְר֣וּ בַעֲצָתָ֑ם וַ֝יָּמֹ֗כּוּ בַּעֲוֺנָֽם

verses.restored: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:

familiar.text: Nevertheless he regarded their affliction, when he heard their cry:

modern.text: Nevertheless He heard their cry; He took note of their distress.

original.text: וַ֭יַּרְא בַּצַּ֣ר לָהֶ֑ם בְּ֝שָׁמְע֗וֹ אֶת רִנָּתָֽם

verses.restored: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.

familiar.text: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.

modern.text: And He remembered His covenant with them, and relented by the abundance of His loving devotion.
